annotations.title: Test an idea of the owner's

description: Puts one idea the owner wants TESTED into Taseli's test queue: 'try a headline with the price', 'test a video with a customer', 'what if the ad shows the team'. Taseli's test calendar runs it before its own ideas, as soon as the account has room and budget (one idea against what runs now, a fixed end, the lesson kept), and shows it on the plan page. Not for a change to make now, and not for a lasting rule. It changes nothing in the ad account by itself: every ad it makes is a decision the owner approves. A queued idea shows on the plan page; no run date is promised.

account.description: An ad account's name, when it is about one account only; omit when it is about the whole business.

idea.description: The idea in one plain English line that stands on its own, keeping the owner's own details (what to show, say or lead with), e.g. 'A headline that opens with the price, against the current headlines.'

platform.description: Only when the owner named a platform or the idea can run on one only (a video: meta or tiktok; a headline: google). Omit when open.

quote.description: The owner's own words, as written (any language). Required when said_by_owner is true.

said_by_owner.description: true only when the owner asked for this test outright in this conversation.

say.description: The same idea, short, in the language of the conversation, as the owner would read it.

name: test_idea

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
